content.value: Suppose that, an online book retailer would like to provide overall evaluation of products based on recommendation from customers. The evaluation is a posterior distribution based on quality of the book. But the problem is, kind customers tend to give high recommendations while dishonest ones give very high or low. Briefly explain a Bayesian model for this real life scenario.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
